file_spec.value: Digital upload in JPG, JPEG, or PNG format

cross_verification.note_en: e-Albania (e-albania.al) is Albania's official government e-services portal (National Agency for the Information Society, under the Council of Ministers), used for passport and ID card applications. Size (4×5cm) matches the current DB value exactly — no conflict. Detailed composition rules (background colour, head height, expression, glasses, headwear) were not exposed in the portion of the service page accessible without an e-Albania login, so they are left unverified rather than sourced to third-party photo-service sites.
